title: War in the Ice
section: The Comic Art of Star Wars
description: War in the Ice trenches of Hoth unfolds, as All Terrain Scout Transports ("chicken walkers") stomp on Rebel troopers protecting their Hoth base in this dramatic illustration by Michael Golden (front), a Marvel Comics pin-up from THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK. In a page from the story drawn by Williamson and Garzon (back), Lando Calrissian realizes just how much peril he's put Han Solo in.
